definitions.land: ≥50% of 2020 residents live on federally recognized reservation or off-reservation trust land, or (Hawaii) ≥10% on Hawaiian Home Lands
definitions.land_area: ≥50% of tract area in reservation or trust land (sensitivity check)
definitions.pop: Native residents ≥20% of population (AIAN alone; in Hawaii, AIAN + NHPI alone)

sources.boundaries: Census TIGER/Line 2024 AIANNH; 2024 cartographic boundary tracts (500k)
sources.blocks: 2020 Census PL 94-171 redistricting file, block level (AIANHH code, P1)

robustness.spec: population lens only, without residents of color

logit.note: Logit with state fixed effects and county-clustered SEs; same controls as the main model on /designations (poverty, income, population, density, unemployment, education, renters, vacancy, home value, residents of color, OZ 1.0, NMTC, rural, CRA, Urban tiers).

consultation.note: Native land or community tracts, by whether the state's tribal_consultation.framework is populated.
